# Alpha Rubber

> Alpha Rubber is a rubber flooring and rubber mat manufacturing and supply company serving customers in the United Arab Emirates. We provide rubber flooring, mats, tiles, rolls, and specialized rubber products for commercial, industrial, fitness, entrance, kitchen, stable, animal, and other applications.

Website: https://alpharubberuae.com/
Location: United Arab Emirates
Industry: Rubber Flooring and Rubber Products
Primary Market: UAE

## About Alpha Rubber

Alpha Rubber provides rubber flooring and mat solutions for a wide range of commercial, industrial, fitness, residential, and specialized applications.

Our product range includes gym flooring, rubber mats, rubber tiles, industrial mats, entrance mats, anti-fatigue mats, kitchen mats, stable mats, animal mats, and specialty rubber products.

Customers looking for rubber flooring and rubber mat solutions in the UAE can explore our product collections through the official Alpha Rubber website.

## Main Product Categories

### Gym & Fitness

Rubber flooring solutions designed for gyms, fitness centres, training facilities, and workout areas.

Products include:

- Gym Mats
- Gym Flooring Rolls
- SBR Tiles
- EPDM Tiles
- Gym Turf
- Judo Mats

Page:
https://alpharubberuae.com/gymandfitness.html

### Industrial Mats

Rubber matting solutions for industrial, commercial, workshop, warehouse, and other demanding environments.

Products include:

- Comfort Rolls
- Octagon Rolls
- Hollow Mat Rolls
- Squarow Rolls
- Bubble Rolls
- Grid Rolls
- Strip Mats
- Tube Mats
- EPDM Rolls

Page:
https://alpharubberuae.com/industrailmats.html

### Entrance & Door Mats

Entrance matting solutions for commercial, residential, office, retail, hospitality, and other building entrances.

https://alpharubberuae.com/Entranceanddoormats.html

Rubber matting solutions intended for areas where users stand for extended periods, including kitchens, workplaces, service areas, and commercial environments.
